Product Features

  • Headboard with wireless charging & USB ports: This is a new upholstered bed that combines two functions: wireless charging, storage. With four open storage compartments at the head of the bed and charging ports on the left and right, it's suitable for a two-person household, both in terms of strain and design.
  • Wireless Charging: Simply place your phone on the charging dock and enjoy fast wireless charging. After many extreme tests and feedback from fans, we use high-performance charging chips and world-class electronic components, to ensure the quality of the phone charging base, it takes about 2-4 hours to give your phone a full charge.**Please note that wireless charging is only supported by mobile phones with wireless charging technology.
  • Storage Design: The bed is equipped with 4 drawers with large capacity. Two sides of the bed are equipped with drawer buckles that allow the drawer to be firmly attached to the bed when the drawer is not in use, so that your bedroom is tidy. The storage boxes are easy to roll out and roll in thanks to the wheels on the bottom.
  • Practicality meets design: Bed skilfully combines elegant design and maximum comfort. Decorative knobs refine the headboard and give it a modern touch.The frame of the bed is mainly made of iron, is durable and has a load capacity of up to 440 LBS. The additional support legs of the center bar can ensure the reliable stability of the bed.
  • Detailed Information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 boxes and they can arrive on different days. If both packages arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.When you move the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor.
